proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E542 (Edible Bone Phosphate)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E542 (edible bone phosphate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it is derived from animal bones, so the animal source (pork/non-zabiha vs halal) must be verified before it can be considered permissible.

proposed.sourceName: Islam Q&A — Fatwa 233750 'Ruling on sugar refined using bone char'
proposed.paraphrase: Holds that bone material burned/processed into a different substance undergoes istihalah (complete transformation) and becomes pure (tahir) — the view of the Hanafi and Maliki schools and the Permanent Committee — the permissive side of the dispute over bone-derived additives.

researcherNote: E542 seeded lenient grade 4 (widely avoided). Kept at avoid: SANHA mushbooh (animal bone) vs the istihalah-purity view — a genuine dispute, and unspecified bone source could be pork, so even leniently verification is required. Two independent tier-1. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
